label: Dubstep / Colour Bass (Melodic Riddim)
tempo_line: Tempo as written 140-150 BPM, felt half-time 70-75 BPM
tempo_note: Tempo is written the sourced dubstep way: 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 (drumstep: about 172-174, felt 86-87). The official melodic dubstep cards say 171 for the same kind of music. Compare by ear before trusting either.
note: Studio-authored recipe, not an official Music 3 template, untested (nothing has been rendered from it yet).

cards.mood: Bright and dreamy: the intro floats on a glassy arpeggio and light pads, a riser builds into a colourful first drop where a catchy synth hook trades with bouncy bass hits, a breakdown goes soft and melodic, and the last drop is brighter…
cards.vocal: No lead singer. Chopped, pitched vocal hits are played like a synth, forming short melodic stabs between the bass phrases.
cards.palette: A detuned supersaw lead plays a catchy, slightly aggressive hook in the drops while a bouncy, vowel-like mid-bass answers it, over a clean sub.
cards.tempo_line: written 145 BPM, felt half-time as 72 BPM

cards.mood: Warm and euphoric: a bright intro leads to a verse over a light beat, the pre-chorus lifts with a riser, and the hook arrives as a colourful drop in which the vocal melody is echoed by a synth hook. A soft bridge sets up a final drop with…
cards.vocal: Singer A (Female). The vocalist possesses a bright, clear, powerful pop timbre with a strong, controlled belt.
cards.palette: A bright, plucky synth arpeggio and warm chords support the voice in the verses. In the drops a detuned supersaw hook and a bouncy mid-bass carry the melody.
cards.tempo_line: written 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 BPM

cards.mood: Moody and emotional: a dark atmospheric pad opens, a slow melodic motif is introduced, the drop combines a lush, sad lead with a restrained riddim-style bass, and the track fades with the pad.
cards.vocal: No lead singer. A few heavily processed vocal fragments, pitched down and drenched in echo, act as ghostly texture rather than lyrics.
cards.palette: A lush, slightly detuned lead plays a sad melodic motif over a restrained, bouncing mid-bass and a clean sub.
cards.tempo_line: written 150 BPM, felt half-time as 75 BPM
